post.description: Announce the given CID to the DHT so other peers can find it.

get.description: Find peers that have announced the given CID to the DHT.
Returns the current bandwidth estimate and number of active streams.
Returns all locally known track metadata entries.

post.description: Store and broadcast a new TrackMetadata entry via gossipsub.

get.description: Case-insensitive search over track title and artist fields.
Returns the TrackMetadata for the given CID.
Returns all currently connected peers along with their composite score.

post.description: Open a connection to the specified peer multiaddr.

get.description:
Returns a single copy-paste-friendly invite code another node can
use to connect to this one, plus whether a publicly reachable
address is known and a note when reachability is limited.

post.description:
Connect to the node identified by an invite code. Malformed,
unsupported, or self-referential codes are rejected with 400; an
unreachable peer fails within a bounded time with 504.

get.description: Returns the composite score for the given peer ID.

post.description:
Records the given CID as the node's current track and marks playback
active. This is a lightweight control-plane operation: it only updates
in-memory state (queryable via GET /playback/status) and does NOT spawn
a P2P download or speaker output. A headless node has no audio device,
so to actually listen, stream the audio over HTTP via
GET /tracks/{cid}/stream instead.

Records the given chunk index as the current-track position. This is a
state-only control-plane operation; it updates state queryable via
GET /playback/status and does not reposition an in-flight HTTP audio
stream (issue a ranged GET on /tracks/{cid}/stream for that).

get.description: Returns whether a track is playing, the current CID, position, and buffer level.

post.description:
Clears the node's current-track state and marks playback inactive.
Like /playback/play this is a state-only control-plane operation; it
does not interrupt an in-flight HTTP audio stream (close the
GET /tracks/{cid}/stream response on the client to stop listening).

get.description: Returns the current item, upcoming items, and play history.

post.description: Add a track to the end of the playback queue.

delete.description: Remove all upcoming items from the queue (history is preserved).

get.description: Returns all previously played items, oldest first.

post.description: Insert a track at the given position in the queue (0 = next to play).

get.description: Returns the node's peer ID, listen addresses, connected peer count, and uptime.
Returns the CID and chunk count for every locally stored track.

post.description: Upload an MP3 file into storage and optionally announce it to the DHT.

delete.description: Remove a track and all its chunks from local storage.

get.description:
Streams the track's MP3 audio bytes in playback order. Works for
both locally-stored tracks and tracks fetched from peers over P2P.
Point a browser <audio> element, VLC, or any HTTP media player at
this URL to listen. The response is chunked audio/mpeg.
